sailors.biography: Inés A. Méndez‑Larminaux is a youth sailor from San Juan, Puerto Rico, and a ninth‑grade student at the University of Puerto Rico High School (UHS). She began competitive sailing at age seven and has represented Puerto Rico internationally in the Optimist class since 2022. Ranked among the top seven Optimist sailors in the world under 15, Inés has earned major titles including Female Vice‑World Champion 2025, North American Female Champion 2024, and South American Female Champion 2025. She is also a three‑time South American Team Racing Champion and a World Team Racing Bronze Medalist. She has also been invited to elite events such as the Regatta of Champions, the RenaissanceRe Junior Gold Cup in Bermuda, and the HKODA Open and National Championships.
sailors.name: Ines  Mendez-Larminaux
